text: The principal pieces of the machine (fig. x.), to damp coins on the edges, are two fiecl laminae, about a fine thick. One half of the legends, of the ring, is engraved on the thickness of one of the laminain, and the other half on the thickelsof the other; and their two laminar and freightly, although the phanchet marked with them he circular.

parsed.modern: The principal pieces of the machine (fig. x.), to damp coins on the edges, are two steel laminae, about a fine thick. One half of the legends, of the ring, is engraved on the thickness of one of the laminas, and the other half on the thickness of the other; and their two laminas are straight, although the planchet marked with them be circular.
